Phobos.Farming.PhobosCropClassDef.label: cereal
Phobos.Farming.PhobosCropClassDef.description: Small grains cut whole and threshed: rice, wheat, barley, oats, rye, sorghum, buckwheat. A combine's grain front takes them.

Phobos.Farming.PhobosCropClassDef.label: pulse
Phobos.Farming.PhobosCropClassDef.description: Dry peas and chickpeas, cut and threshed like a cereal. A combine's grain front takes them.

Phobos.Farming.PhobosCropClassDef.label: oilseed
Phobos.Farming.PhobosCropClassDef.description: Small-seeded oil crops such as canola, cut and threshed like a cereal. A combine's grain front takes them.

Phobos.Farming.PhobosCropClassDef.label: row crop
Phobos.Farming.PhobosCropClassDef.description: Tall crops grown in rows, such as corn and sunflowers, which need a row-crop header rather than a grain front.

Phobos.Farming.PhobosCropClassDef.label: forage
Phobos.Farming.PhobosCropClassDef.description: Grass grown for hay, mown and baled rather than threshed.

Phobos.Farming.PhobosCropClassDef.label: fibre
Phobos.Farming.PhobosCropClassDef.description: Cotton and similar crops, picked by a picker rather than threshed.

Phobos.Farming.PhobosCropClassDef.label: root crop
Phobos.Farming.PhobosCropClassDef.description: Potatoes and other crops lifted from the ground by a digger rather than cut.
